item.title: Slamdance 2026 Lineup Sets L.A. Return With ‘Back on Track,’ ‘Brailled It,’ ‘The Tallest Dwarf’ & ‘You Look Fine’ Leading Unstoppable Slate
item.description: The 2026 Slamdance Film Festival unveiled its line-up today, as the artist-led organization “by filmmakers, for filmmakers” returns for its second year in Los Angeles. Running in-person from February 19 to 25, 2026, and virtually from February 24 to March 6, 2026, on the Slamdance Channel, the festival programs 141 films, including 50 world premieres, from over 50 countries—an international snapshot of emerging voices and boundary-pushing work. item.description: The final Sundance Film Festival in Park City, Utah, is a little over a week away, and organizers are putting the finishing touches on what will be a historic event.
